reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing getMonthWideCategories selector that all month-wide actions already call, and reuses the shared extractTagsFromText parser.

duplication.why: The #fixed check appears once; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The exclusion lives beside the hidden and template exclusions in the month-wide selector in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Selector, comment, a test and a release note following the repo's upcoming-release-notes convention.

maintainability.why: Centralised and readable; the rule is split between SQL and a JS post-filter with a hard-coded 'fixed' literal, and tests cover only setZero.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action including copyPreviousMonth
